platform: macOS 27.2.1 arm64; Apple Clang/SDK 27.2; Release FSKit=ON

baseline_reproduction.result: The injected orphan cleanup failure disconnected session-close before the original errno response could be read.

validation.execution: macOS 27.2.1 arm64 Apple Clang/SDK 27.2 Release FSKit ON; no-Git read-only source; deny-default sandbox excludes home/keychain/credentials/publishing checkout; loopback-only tests

paths_per_fault_pair: final close of an unlinked open inode returns the original errno; explicit close reports the error
poisoned session cleanup on short-lease expiry retains counts and mount fencing
explicit close after an already-poisoned write returns EIO; SIGTERM with another unexpired linked handle exits cleanly
checks: last_committed_seq, indexed_objects, and object_roots unchanged before/after injected failure and across diagnostics
status and storage-profile remain available after poisoning
conflicting mutable write and restore retain EBUSY fencing
bounded shutdown removes its socket and exits zero
restart preserves retained revision bytes, leaves unlinked path absent, and passes fs-check/check
coverage.recovery_scope: Whole old or new publication after restart; exact in-memory orphan counters are not required to persist across restart.

limits: Daemon RPC session cleanup only; no native mount cleanup or cache invalidation qualification.
No automatic recovery; poisoned storage still requires stop/reopen and repository checks.
No physical durability, power-loss, kernel-crash, quota, or signing qualification.
No wire framing or storage format changes.
